description: Records a marker: a label for this moment of the running session (e.g. run-3 before the third repetition of a test), on the clock logcat lines and crashes are timed on: the device clock plus the offset measured once at session start (to within tens of ms; not if that measurement failed, or after the device's clock was set during the session). search_logcat and get_crashes take sinceMarker / untilMarker to count per run without clock math or clearing the device's log buffer. Marking a label again moves it to now (replaced gives its old time). Labels: 1-40 letters, digits, _ . : -; at most 200 per session. Markers belong to the session: a new session starts without any. A mark sent right after start_session lands on the new session. Returns the marker and markers {total, newest: the newest 20, oldest first}, as status does.
name: mark
title: Mark a point in time
